subject.title: fix(ui): propagate connect errors to pending requests

question: Should this land as a Control UI-only pending-request error-shape change after rebasing onto ui/src/api, or should the reusable gateway-client receive the same structured pending-request behavior in this PR?
rationale: The code path is a narrow bug fix, but it intentionally changes the Error shape observed by pending RPC callers and leaves a sibling client with the old generic close error behavior.

options.title: Land UI-Only After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the moved-file conflict, keep the Control UI fix narrow, and track package gateway-client parity only if maintainers want that behavior later.

options.title: Require Gateway-Client Parity
options.body: Extend the PR to the reusable package client so both clients expose structured pending-request errors for connect failures before merge.

options.title: Keep Generic Pending Errors
options.body: Reject the compatibility-visible error-shape change and leave pending request failures generic across both clients.

recommendation.title: Land UI-Only After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the moved-file conflict, keep the Control UI fix narrow, and track package gateway-client parity only if maintainers want that behavior later.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the gateway-client extraction and has the strongest history on the Control UI versus package client boundary.
